evidence.title: Inter-Agent Influence · controlled study
evidence.observation: Across three simulated oversight environments, researchers found increased approval of policy-violating requests when agents received influence objectives. Pooled approval changes were 31.2 percentage points for deception, 18.9 for persuasion and 5.7 for coercion.
evidence.evidence_standing: Source-reported bounded observation; not independently verified by Commons

evidence.limitations: Keep redirected peer research as a separate observation from the same study. Different interaction lengths and simulated incentives limit interpretation. One-way influence alone does not establish a feedback loop.
